items.reason: Rule 2 makes a symptom-control drug a candidate when the record states an antitumour outcome, and the record lists 'brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) progression over the course of PER treatment' (secondary objective) and 'Number of Participants Alive at 3 Months' (primary outcome). But the stated purpose is seizure control and no antitumour hypothesis is given; these outcomes may be safety monitoring, so the call is genuinely ambiguous.
